messages.en:
{07 02 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} I gotta
talk to you about my
catchphrase!
{07 06 00}To tell you the truth{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
I'm kind of tired of saying
"{04 02 00}" all the time.
{07 0b 00}Can you maybe help me
think of something cooler
to say, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Pean
sinuga oma hüüdlausest
rääkima!
{07 06 00}Ausalt öeldes{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
olen väsinud sellest, et
ütlen kogu aeg „{04 02 00}”.
{07 0b 00}Kas aitaksid mul välja
mõelda midagi lahedamat,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 02 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}! {01 01 00}{07 16 00}You know, I'm
getting kinda tired of my
signature "{04 02 00}."
{07 06 00}I need something to say
that'll up my cool quotient,
like {04 0b 00}.
messages.et:
{07 02 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}! {01 01 00}{07 16 00}Tead, olen
oma tunnuslausest
„{04 02 00}” veidi tüdinud.
{07 06 00}Vajan midagi, mis tõstaks
mu lahedusetaset,
nagu {04 0b 00}.

{07 00 00}Mis?! Tõesti?{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0a 00}Jess! See
teeb mind nii õnnelikuks,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}I really think I need some
kind of catchphrase.

{07 0b 00}But isn't there something
cooler for me to say,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Ma tõesti arvan, et vajan
mingit hüüdlauset.

{07 0b 00}Aga kas pole midagi
lahedamat, mida öelda,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} did you
know that every superhero
needs a catchphrase?
{07 14 00}Yeah, it's a fact. {01 00 00 05 00}They need
something to say when they
first swoop into a room!
You see where I'm going
with this? See, I'm a
superhero myself...
{07 0a 00}So I need a catchphrase,
too!{01 00 00 05 00} And it's gotta scare
off dastardly villains!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} kas sa
teadsid, et superkangelane
vajab hüüdlauset?
{07 14 00}Jah, fakt. {01 00 00 05 00}Nad vajavad
midagi, mida öelda, kui
nad tuppa sööstavad!
Saad aru, kuhu ma sihin?
Näed, ma olen ise
superkangelane...
{07 0a 00}Nii et ka mina vajan
hüüdlauset!{01 00 00 05 00} Ja see peab
peletama alatuid kurikaelu!

messages.en:
{07 1b 00}Aw, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 01 00} {07 16 00}Don't you
know that a superhero also
needs a loyal sidekick?
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Ohh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 01 00} {07 16 00}Kas sa ei
tea, et superkangelane
vajab ka ustavat abilist?
